findings.text: Charging the two lines of `Connection.withDatabase` to one-time additions and their removal to CREATE TABLE overstates both the shared cost and the per-kind savings by two lines. Fix: Assign both sides of the move to the same category so they cancel across packages.

The table reports changes in caller files, but the task asks for lines changed in caller declarations: the four model callers account for +26/−11 and the twelve fixture callers for +132/−158 when their docstrings are included. Fix: Report those declaration totals and list imports, module documentation, and the three moved helpers separately.

“The tactic” gives no declaration count, and the +29/−21 total combines `sendRule`, which named the replaced laws, with supporting changes to `runSend`, `hintedKinds`, `closeFailure`, and `schemaKinds`. Fix: Count `sendRule` as the direct caller and report the other tactic changes separately.

The table gives zero lines for the replacement of `runScriptStep_insert_ne_oneOf`, although `runScriptStep_ne_oneOf_of_not_query` supplies the fact in eight statement lines at both revisions. Fix: Report retained theorem names and statement lengths for each applicable row alongside the new-line counts, keeping 64 as the distinct new-or-restated subtotal.

The record says the count facts select the INSERT case, but `insert_new_check` uses `items_counts_ok` only after selecting the success case. Fix: Say that readiness and outcome facts select the case, while row and count facts establish its postcondition.
